meta.title: File manager
meta.description: Manage workspace files in the browser: click a row to enter a folder or preview a file. Word/Excel/PowerPoint are parsed on the host into selectable text, spreadsheet grids, and slide decks; text, images, PDFs, video, and audio render directly. Also upload, download, create folders, delete permanently (with confirmation), and ZIP a directory. Workspaces are discovered automatically and paths never leave them. Adds one-click download on delivered-file cards.
